jobs_results.title: Chartered Accountant | Accounts & Finance
jobs_results.description:
CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT | ACCOUNTS & FINANCE

Company: KIMIRICA Lifestyle

Department: Finance & Accounts

Location: Unit 14, Lunawat Group Campus, Near Airport, Indore, Madhya Pradesh – 452005

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)




ROLE SUMMARY

KIMIRICA is looking for a Chartered Accountant to manage and strengthen our Accounts & Finance function as we scale our luxury D2C business. The role will cover accounting, taxation, compliance, MIS, audits, working capital, commercial finance, and financial controls.

D2C / E-commerce experience is mandatory.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting & Financial Reporting: Manage day-to-day accounting, GL, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, month-end closure, and financial reporting.Accounts Payable & Receivable: Oversee vendor/customer accounting, ageing, payments, collections, reconciliations, and working capital.D2C & Commercial Finance: Manage D2C/e-commerce and marketplace reconciliations covering sales, settlements, commissions, returns, refunds, and payment gateways.Taxation, Compliance & Audit: Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, statutory compliance, internal/statutory audits, and related documentation.MIS & Business Finance: Prepare MIS, P&L analysis, budgets, forecasts, cash-flow reports, variance analysis, and profitability reports for management.Controls & Process Improvement: Strengthen financial controls, inventory accounting, cost management, automation, and finance processes across the business.


KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

CA qualification is mandatory.D2C / E-commerce experience is mandatory.Strong knowledge of Accounts, Taxation, Audit, MIS, Compliance, Working Capital, and Financial Controls.Experience in FMCG, Beauty, Personal Care, Lifestyle, or Consumer Brands will be preferred.Strong Excel, ERP, analytical and stakeholder management skills.
